label: early original-phase token following a run of g/h/j/2/3/i
explanation: Fires almost only in the original phase (99.5% of mass), mostly at t=3-4 (80% of mass), never at t=0-1 and almost never in the delimiter or copy phase. It needs the two previous inputs to come from a small set {g,h,j,2,3,i}; prev_tok h (14.6x lift) and 3 (8.3x) and prev2_tok g (14.4x) are the strongest. The current token is usually y/t/g/j/u/s/w/h/2/q/k. The largest activations come on prefixes starting j g h, j h h, j g 3 or n g h, where the first token is j or n. This predicate covers about 70% of the mass but has only ~6.5% precision: many steps with the same local context stay silent. That suggests the feature reads a specific hidden-state combination of the whole prefix that these token sets only roughly capture. Narrower versions (prev h/3, prev2 g/h) raise precision to ~0.30 but cut recall to ~0.28 (F1 0.29).

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: prev_tok=3 (+6.02), prev_tok=h (+5.98), orig0=n (+4.73), prev2_tok=g (+4.52), prev_tok=i (+4.18), prev2_tok=3 (+3.93). Lower it: orig_idx=-1 (-6.24), in_tok=n (-3.41), in_tok=3 (-3.25), in_tok=b (-3.24).
